implementation: Detached Linux supervisors write identity-scoped heartbeats to a separate atomic heartbeat file. Heartbeats do not mix with progress/event logs; stale or mismatched detached heartbeats are surfaced as unknown rather than reported as healthy.

The attach follow loop consumes Ctrl+C as a viewer-only detach and leaves the backend run active. Cooperative stop requests the existing step-boundary stop path; force interrupts the verified supervisor and worker process group.

Foreground run admission and reconciliation remain protected by the project activity lock; unknown supervisor identity remains protected. Progress, logs, events and heartbeat retain separate ownership and read paths.
